AI agents filling in this template:
- Replace every comment with real content. Delete sections that don't apply rather than writing "N/A".
- Never claim tests were run or passed unless you ran them in this session. Say what was and wasn't verified.
- Take the Linear ID from the branch name. If there isn't one, ask the user - don't invent one.
- Use "Closes" if this PR completes the issue, "Part of" if it's one of several PRs. Use the magic word without a colon, as in the Linear docs.
- Be concise. British English, no filler, don't restate the diff line by line.

-->

Closes <!-- e.g. HEI-123, or say why there's no ticket -->

<!--
Linear magic words (no colon): https://linear.app/docs/github#magic-words
- Closes / Fixes / Resolves HEI-123: moves the issue through our workflow and to the "on merge" status when merged.
- Part of / Refs / Towards HEI-123: moves the issue through our workflow, but doesn't apply the "on merge" status.
- Related to HEI-123: links only, no status changes.
- Ignore HEI-123: stops an issue mentioned elsewhere from being linked.
- HEI-NEW: creates and links a new issue in that team, in Started status and assigned to you.
-->
